transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well... my mind just feels a bit foggy lately. I don't really know how else to explain it. I can't even seem to keep my place in my old cataloguing notes at work... or, you know, decide what simple thing to do next. So... I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

I suppose... yeah. I don't really know if I'd use the word depressed, but... most days lately I just end up sitting at the kitchen table. It just feels like the color has gone out of everything. I have these old watercolor books at home... usually I like them, but lately looking at them just makes me feel heavy. I just don't have much interest.
Have you had thoughts about wanting to die or hurting yourself?
No... no, nothing like that. I just... I just feel tired, I guess. I wouldn't do anything like that.
Did this start after something particularly stressful happened in your life?
I don't... no. Not really. Nothing out of the ordinary happened. Just everyday things, I guess. I can't really point to anything.
How has your sleep been lately?

Not great, I suppose. I mean... I go to bed tired enough. But then I just wake up. Usually around four in the morning. I just... lie there. Thinking about, I don't know... what I'm supposed to do with myself now. Just waiting for the sun to come up, I guess.
Have you noticed your appetite has decreased lately?
I suppose. I just... have to remind myself to eat lately. My wife says I've been leaving my rice and soup half-finished. I never used to waste a meal before, so... yeah. I guess it has.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?
Worthless? ... I don't know about that. I wouldn't... no. I don't think so. I just... haven't been doing much lately. That's all.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

I... yes. I suppose so. It's actually part of why I came in. Everything just feels a bit... foggy lately. 

At work, I'll be looking at my old cataloguing notes and I just... I can't keep my place. Or I'll sit there and I can't even decide what simple thing to do next. It just... doesn't come to me.
Have you been forgetting things more than usual lately?
I don't... I don't think so. No. My memory seems alright. It's just... like I said, hard to stay focused on what I'm doing. But I'm not really forgetting things.
Have you been feeling especially anxious or worried lately?
Anxious? ... No, I don't think so. I'm not really much of a worrier. It's mostly just... what I said before. Just the trouble getting my work done.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?

I... I guess so. My body just feels... slow, I suppose. Like even just walking to the corner store takes more effort than it should. Or... just sorting papers at my desk. It all just feels harder to do.
Have you been feeling this way nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I suppose... yeah. It's been about three weeks, I think. Ever since that first rush of retirement kind of... faded. Things just shifted after that. So, yes.
Have you had any recent medical illness or changes in your medications?
No... I haven't been sick. And I haven't had any changes to my pills or anything. So, no.
